verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no mentions of Godot's 3D renderer, PBR materials, global illumination/baked lighting, shadows, or post-processing effects — only generic references to 2D rendering, node/scene system, and scripting. Although this is a well-known Godot feature area, per the judging rules we cannot rely on outside knowledge, and the axis clearly applies to a game engine, so absence of evidence yields 'none'. Missing for 10: any documentation or hands-on evidence of PBR material system, GI/lightmapping, shadow mapping, or post-processing pipeline.
